notes.title: 📢 Minor Update — Difficulty Options for ALL games
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45084722/b67202b06236a28290131c7d2c1628fc51937bb4.png[/img]
Hey! Hope you are all doing great.

We've been reading many feedback about the game feeling too challenging since the last update — especially for solo players or smaller teams.

We really want the game to be fun and flexible for everyone, and we want everyone to be happy. [b]So today we’re rolling out a small update that adds a bit more breathing room for those who want it[/b] (we made one a couple of days ago, but we went a little deeper in this one)

[h2]🛠️ Difficulty Options when you create a game[/h2]
You can pick between [b]Easy[/b], [b]Normal[/b], or [b]Hard [/b]— which will adjust quotas, earnings, price of medkits and a few other balancing tweaks to better fit your style of play. Whether you're running solo or playing casually with friends, you now have more control over your experience.

[b]We also made a few additional tweaks based on your feedback[/b] — like rebalancing the sewer, life back to 50 instead of 25 when you respawn after death, adjusting the trampoline, adding more medkits, and other small things that should smooth things out.

These are small changes, but we hope they help make your sessions more fun, fair, and flexible — and just know we’ll keep listening and improving things along the way 💛

Thanks so much! 
Lucas & Bruno

notes.title: 🎉 OUR MAJOR UPDATE IS LIVE!! 🎉
notes.content:

[h1][b]The update is now officially out[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45084722/da6af52269fd6948b8b3e93684b14b00440f6d2b.gif[/img]

notes.title: 📢 BIG NEWS — MAJOR UPDATE DROPS THIS THURSDAY!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45084722/b67202b06236a28290131c7d2c1628fc51937bb4.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Hope you’re all doing great. We’ve got an exciting news to share 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45084722/068062e6706ab7f20e5daf0b26fc45c9d061ee62.gif[/img]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]The Major Update lands this Thursday![/h1]
This is by faaaaar the biggest update we’ve ever done, and if you haven’t been following the dev updates, here’s a quick recap of what’s coming:

📸 [b]Photos now have directly a dollar value[/b] (in-game, obviously😊), you earn money directly based on what you capture
🎯 [b]Objectives are per-session[/b], not cumulative, making each run more focused, rewarding, and impactful.
🛍️[b]Shop in the lobby[/b] with many new items: cameras, armors, fireworks & more
🎒 [b]Loot can now spawn[/b] both inside AND outside
👽 [b]Lots of new enemies & NPCs[/b] (including survivors!)
🌉 [b]Brand new map[/b]: Brooklyn Bridge 
🛠️ Many [b]level & game design tweaks[/b]
📺 [b]New recap screen[/b] at the end of runs
⚙️ [b]Better performance[/b] & bug fixes
... And many more things 🙂 

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]What’s new since the Beta Test?[/h2]
Once again (and I know I repeat myself, but I don't care): to those of you who helped us during the beta — thank you SO much! 💛 We've added new content, rebalanced things, and fixed a lot of what you reported:

📊 We tweaked the difficulty to make it a bit more forgiving while keeping the challenge
💵 You can now earn money for your pictures even if you don’t reach the quota
🩹 More medkits in the store
📸 Better feedback on duplicate photos, and improved UI in the gallery + HUD
🎨 UI icons have been cleaned up for all items
🎶 Placeholder NPC voices and others have been replaced
👤 Added 1 new NPC and 1 new enemy 👀
⌛ Countdown warning now shows up to avoid surprise endings
🦶 Slight nerf to Big Foot (he had it coming)
🎁 And... a few small surprises we won’t spoil 😉
🐛 Plus more bug fixes & optimization improvements

As I said, we’ve carefully rebalanced the difficulty to make things a bit more forgiving 😊. We’re still keeping an eye on it, so if it still feels off, don’t worry—we’re listening and open to adjusting more!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]That’s it for now! We seriously can’t wait for you to try this new version.[/b]
Thanks again to all of you for the support, feedback, and chaos 💥


See you Thursday 🚁

— Lucas & Bruno

notes.title: BIG UPDATE IN THE WORKS
notes.content:
[h1]BIG UPDATE IN THE WORKS 🎉[/h1]

Hey everyone! First things first—THANK YOU![b] More than 650,000 of you have played The Headliners[/b], and honestly, that number is just insane. We’re beyond happy... thank you ❤️

I wanted to give you a little update on what we’re working on with Bruno! [b]Our next update is going to be a pretty big one[/b], so it will take us more time. We will release this one in May. [b]We’re still actively fixing bugs you report and will release patches in the meantime that could even include some more content[/b]. Will let you know ! 

One of the biggest things we’re focusing on right now is [b]revamping the Progression System[/b]. We want runs to feel more rewarding and to give players more tools and goals to work towards. That means rethinking [b]how you earn money, adjusting objectives to make headlines, adding systems to reward exploration (especially in the interiors), and introducing a whole new shop with more useful objects to help you out[/b]. From the tests we’ve done so far, it’s already feeling really promising! Oh, and of course—[b]we’ve been cooking up some new aliens and NPCs too, among many other things.[/b] Not spoiling anything just yet 👀

Since this update will bring a lot of changes, we’ll likely be reaching out to you for playtesting at some point. Your feedback will be super important in helping us balance everything and make sure it all feels great.

We’re so excited for this—seriously, you have no idea. Can’t wait to share more soon! :HappyGif: 

Thanks again, you’re all amazing.

notes.title: What we're working on!
notes.content:
[h1]What We’re Working On![/h1]

Hey everyone!

Hope you’re all doing great! Just wanted to drop in with an update on what we’re working on. This isn’t exactly a roadmap, but it should give you a good idea of what’s coming next!

[h2]💥 350K PLAYERS?!?[/h2]
More than [b]350,000 of you have played The Headliners![/b] That’s absolutely HUGE, and we can’t thank you enough for all the support. ❤️

[h2]🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
Bruno and I haven’t taken a single day off since launch—we’ve been fully focused on fixing bugs and improving the game as much as possible. Some of these bugs have been tricky since they only happen in specific conditions (VPNs, localization issues, etc.), but we’re optimistic that most will be fixed soon! 
... Of course, fixing one thing can sometimes create new bugs, so we’re taking the time to do things right while moving as fast as we can. Thank you for your patience!

[h2]📢 Next Content Update (Coming Soon)[/h2]
We’re also rushing to have a new content update ready by[b] the end of next week[/b], BUT we need to make sure everything is tested properly before release. If needed, [b]it may take an extra week[/b], but trust us — we’re going as fast as one can!

[i]Here’s what’s planned for this next update:
✅ New outdoor map 🌆
✅ New interior maps 🏢
✅ New aliens (indoors & outdoors!) 👽
✅ More avatars 🎭
✅ Other improvements & bug fixes 🛠️[/i]

[h2]🛠️ Modding System & Creator Kit[/h2]
You have been a LOT (like a lot) to ask for this. [b]So we’re actively exploring adding modding support through a Creator Kit[/b]. This is a big task, so while it’s one of our top priorities, it will take at least a couple of months before it’s fully ready.

To speed things up, we’re considering launching a limited version first and looking into getting some extra help to make it happen faster. We’ll keep you posted!

[h2]📢 Your Suggestions Matter![/h2]
[b]We see ALL your suggestions[/b]— and even if we can’t add everything, we’re reading and considering them for future updates! Keep them coming. 

[h2]💬 Why No Full Roadmap?[/h2]
Right now, we’re simply moving as fast as we can, and we haven’t had the time to properly estimate how long some features will take to develop. That’s why we don’t have a full roadmap yet—[b]but don’t worry, we’ll keep you updated![/b]

[h2]❤️ Thank You![/h2]
[b]As always, thank you SO MUCH for your support[/b]—it truly means the world to us. Huge shoutout to everyone helping report bugs, give feedback, and make The Headliners even better. We’re in this for the long run!

Oh, and a new contest is coming soon… stay tuned! 👀📸

Lucas & Bruno

notes.title: 🛠️ Dev Update: Priorities and Progress 📸
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! [/b]

As promised, here’s an update on our current planning for the january launch. To be honest, it’s pretty tricky to set a definitive timeline since we’re moving as fast as we can and often reprioritize tasks based on testing.

But here’s a look at our biggest priorities right now (not exhaustive!):

🎮[b] Stabilizing the game:[/b] Fixing reported bugs, crashes, and optimizing overall performance.
🌍 [b]Translations: [/b]Preparing the game for multiple languages.
📸 [b]Photo download system:[/b] Letting you save your in-game pictures to your computer.
💾 [b]Save system:[/b] So you can keep your progress and continue later with your friends.
🎶 [b]Finishing sound design:[/b] Adding SFX for survivors, soldiers, and music.
🖼️ [b]HQ map revamp:[/b] Showcasing some of your best masterpiece photos in the lobby.
🕹️[b] Steam Deck compatibility:[/b] Making sure you can play smoothly on it.
🔍 [b]Investigating all your ideas[/b], among them:
- Objects scattered around the map (some useful, some hilariously useless).
- Making exteriors feel more alive and dynamic.
- Improved customization: Adding more options and tweaking existing avatars (some are barely picked).

We’re also looking into adding Selfie Mode for the launch (fingers crossed 🤞) and will likely work on new maps and interiors next. After that, we’d love to explore adding more enemies, NPCs, and objects—but let’s not get ahead of ourselves, but as you can see the list is already pretty long for two.

Don’t worry though—we move fast, eheh. 😄

Thanks for sticking with us, and have an awesome day, friends!

notes.title: 🎮 Playtest Finished! 🎮
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! [/b]

The playtest has officially ended, and Bruno and I are blown away by everything you brought to the table—your dedication, your feedback, and, honestly, some of the most questionable photo compositions we’ve ever seen. 😅

First off, [b]THANK YOU![/b] 💖 Honestly, you’re the best... This community is something special, and we’re so lucky to have you.

Here are some wild numbers from the playtest:
-[b] 5200 players[/b] tried the game 🎮
-[b] 368,000 photos[/b] were snapped 📸
- And... [b]16,200 journalists were killed[/b]. RIP 🕊️💀

To those who ran into big bugs like crashes or not being able to play, our deepest apologies 💔. That sucks, and we feel you. We’ve got a few ideas about what went wrong and will be investigating. We might even reach out to some of you soon to test fixes, so stay tuned.

Your feedback has been invaluable. From bug reports to crazy photo moments, every bit helps us make the game better. We’ll be reviewing everything and sharing our updated plans in the next few days — right now, as you may already know we’re aiming for a[b] late January launch![/b] 🎯

And don’t forget: [b]wishlist the game on Steam and convince your friends to do the same![/b] It makes a huge difference in how much Steam promotes the game, and honestly, it’s a small thing that helps us in a big way. 🙏

We love you all. Seriously, you’re the best. Thanks for making this playtest so memorable—and slightly chaotic. 😉

Catch you soon!

Lucas & Bruno 🚁

notes.title: Progress Update: New Features, Big Fixes, and Exciting News!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hope you’re all doing great! Just wanted to share some news about how things are going with the game. Bruno and I have been super busy working on replayability since the last playtest. 

Here's what’s new:
👾  [b]Many more enemies![/b] Soldiers got some upgrades too—but they’re still very much WIP.
🌆  [b]2 new exterior maps![/b] That makes 4 exterior locations now to explore - will work on new interiors in the coming weeks
📈  [b]A deeper progression system[/b]. The longer you stay in NYC, the more dangerous it gets. But we’re still balancing it—right now, the first areas might be too easy. We’ll definitely need your help here because we’ve completely lost our “first-player perspective.” 😅
🛒 [b]The shop is coming to life![/b] Once you’ve made headlines and earned some cash, you can buy better cameras, protective gear, and other cool stuff we’ll reveal soon. 👀
🎯 [b]Improved scoring system![/b] It’s clearer and more fun to play with now.
⚡ [b]Better optimization![/b] Runs smoother 
🎵[b] And a massive thanks to Adrien Ardilouze[/b] , who made the entire sound design of the game! Every eerie noise, tense moment, and alien scream? That’s all him. 👏
🐛 Fixed tons of bugs and collisions. Seriously, there were way too many!
...And probably a ton of other little things we’ve improved. Long story short: it’s progressing well! 


ALSO Big news! We hit 4,700 wishlists on Steam 🎉 
AND we are extremely honoured to have got nominated for two indie game festivals! Will share more soon. 

Thank you so much for all your support—it really means the world to us! 🙏❤️
